updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot


User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may be unable to view the Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG) breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may be unable to view the PAYG breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Affected admins are seeing the following message:
 
"Breakdown unavailable

We couldn't load the Pre-purchased (P3) versus pay-as-you-go breakdown right now. Please try again later."

Current status: Our monitoring has identified an increase in errors when loading the PAYG breakdown pane within the Microsoft 365 admin center. We've analyzed browser captures and determined that a recent change to an API that facilitates PAYG breakdown reporting isn't responding to requests as expected, resulting in impact. We're in the process of developing a fix to remediate this issue and will provide a remediation timeline once available.

Scope of impact: Any admin attempting to access the PAYG breakdown pane within the Microsoft 365 admin center may be affected. 

Next update by: Friday, September 18, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC

Title: Admins may be unable to view the Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG) breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may have been unable to view the PAYG breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Affected admins may have seen the following message:
 
"Breakdown unavailable

We couldn't load the Pre-purchased (P3) versus pay-as-you-go breakdown right now. Please try again later."

Final status: We've identified that as a result of the API that facilitates PAYG breakdown reporting not responding to requests as expected, admins that should not have had access to open the usage breakdown panel were able to access it. We completed deployment of our fix that corrects the criteria for which admins can open that panel, re-released the feature, and confirmed that the actions remediated the impact.

Scope of impact: Any admin attempting to access the PAYG breakdown pane within the Microsoft 365 admin center may have been affected. 

Start time: Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC

End time: Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent change to an API that facilitates PAYG breakdown reporting isn't responding to requests as expected, which caused admins to be able to open the usage breakdown panel, despite not meeting the criteria to use the feature. 

Next steps: 
-We're reviewing our API change testing and validation procedures to identify and prevent similar issues with admins having access to features for which they don't meet the criteria for from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
